game.description: The game this process runs (protocol/games.json); the client checks it against the link's configured game.

family.description: The game's engine family, from the catalogue (MG1; absent on an older bridge: the client takes it from the catalogue).

compat.description: The adapter's real compatibility limits (MG1); absent means the catalogue's profile for the game. visitor (FOREIGN_POKEMON_PLAN §4.15): whether the stand-in species registered.

session.description: Random per gen1-bridge start, so a client can tell a restart from a reconnect.

tested.description: The engine version this gen1-bridge was tested with; the client warns when engine differs.

union_room.description: Whether the engine's Union Room setting patched this boot's Pokemon Centers (it must be off: the export never sees the patch); the client shows what to switch off while it is on.
